findings.location: Paragraph with garden example (third paragraph after "To typer humanisme" section) — sentence listing gardening actions
findings.source_quote: He, too, went out each day and watered, pruned, weeded, and fertilized.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the mistranslated phrase "luktet ut ugress" with a correct Norwegian equivalent such as "fjernet ugress" so the list reads: "Han gikk også ut hver dag og vannet, beskar, fjernet ugress og gjødslet." Preserve existing HTML and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Han gikk også ut hver dag og vannet, beskar, luktet ut ugress og gjødslet.
